snippet.title: Growth Daily GameDevLog [100] - 100 days learning Godot #devlog #gamedev #godot4 #indiegame #gaming
snippet.description:
Everyday live on twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/growthdevlog

This is my 100th Devlog for my Game "Growth". I will tell you how far i come in the past 100 Days and talk about some challenging problems and how to keep me motivated.
